_instructions: Model tier -> model name per CLI; the generator copies these verbatim. Rule of thumb: strong = complex work (evaluator, second opinion, hard features), standard = implementation. Claude: opus for complex work, sonnet for implementation. ChatGPT: gpt-6-astra for complex work, gpt-6.1-sol for executing. Copilot's strong tier is a ChatGPT model on purpose, so a Copilot second opinion next to a Claude builder comes from another vendor. Set a tier to "auto" (or leave it out) to let the CLI choose; when a named model is unavailable the harness falls back and the CLI chooses its own. sensitive_globs: a feature whose paths match one gets the evaluator's security checklist; override per repo.
